lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity local maxima concentrated in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a faint grid-like arrangement across the central visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp pixel intensity gradient transitioning from high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge to shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A white, high-luminance rectangular object, identified as an external scientific tag, is visible attached to the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
